name: Homeboyz Entertainment Plc
source: Homeboyz Entertainment Plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2023, announcement of audited results, absolute Kenya Shillings (Kshs), not thousands. | CRON 20261013: H1 2026 column added from the Homeboyz Entertainment Plc half year results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (press release carried by Kenyan Wall Street, Business Today and Nyongesa Sande, all agreeing): turnover 92.50 million, gross profit 29.51 million, operating loss 42.52 million, finance costs 92,616, loss after tax 42.61 million. Cost of Sales is the Revenue less Gross Profit identity on the two printed lines and is tagged derived. The issuer printed no income tax line and loss after tax equals profit before tax to the printed digit, so Income Tax is stored 0 (the same basis as the stored FY2023 column). EPS is left empty: this interim announcement does not print one. | CRON 20261013: FY2025 column added from the Homeboyz Entertainment Plc audited/announced results for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Business Today and Nyongesa Sande both report turnover 386.33 million, gross profit 155.98 million and profit after tax 28.96 million, up 14.3% on the 25.33 million of FY2024): Revenue 386,330,000, Gross Profit 155,980,000, Profit Before Tax 28,960,000, Net Profit 28,960,000. Cost of Sales is the Revenue less Gross Profit identity on the two printed lines and is tagged derived. FY2024 is not added: the outlets report two different revenue figures for it (382.83 million against 309.2 million) and the issuer announcement was not reachable, so the column is left absent rather than guessed. The issuer prints no income tax line and pre-tax and after-tax profit are the same printed number, so Income Tax is stored 0.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: stored positive to the dataset convention: Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit
rows.derivedCellFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit (both printed)

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
